summary: Aurelion Inc., a Hong Kong-based digital gold infrastructure company, furnished a Form 6-K on July 27, 2026, reporting unaudited financial results for the fiscal quarter ended June 30, 2026. The press release details business highlights, including a subscription of 8,000 units of XAUt into the XAUE yield protocol, and provides net asset value figures: total NAV of $91.9 million, NAV per share of $2.44, with 33,318 units of XAUt held. It also reports an operating loss of $24.4 million driven by fair value loss on gold depreciation. This is a routine earnings disclosure, not a special situation; no transaction, strategic review, or corporate action is announced.
